name: Scarlet Monastery Armory
summary: Behind iron gates, recruits train and weapons are forged for the Scarlet Crusade in Scarlet Monastery Armory. Herod, the Scarlet Champion, commands the wing.

sections.title: The Foundry of Zeal
sections.body: The Scarlet Monastery once sheltered Lordaeron's peaceful priesthood. After the Third War, the Crusade remade the Armory into a forge, a weapons depot, and a proving ground. Scarlet footmen, conjurers, and crusaders train in its open yards and deep halls. They mean to purge the Scourge and all they judge tainted. The wing is sealed from the Grand Vestibule. Only those bearing the Scarlet Key from the neighboring Library may enter.

sections.title: The Hall of Champions
sections.body: Towering statues of the Scarlet Crusade's heroes fill the Hall of Champions. Herod, the Scarlet Champion, oversees the hall. The brutal warrior is famed among the crusaders for his ferocity and whirling attacks, and trains new zealots himself. When battle presses him hard, his recruits rush into the chamber to fight and die for their champion.

faq.q: How do you get inside the Armory?
faq.answer: The Armory door in the Grand Vestibule is locked. You can retrieve the Scarlet Key from the chest behind Arcanist Doan in the Library's Athenaeum, or bring a rogue skilled enough to pick the lock.

faq.q: Who leads the troops in the Armory?
aliases: who is in charge of armory
faq.answer: Herod, the Scarlet Champion, commands the wing from the Hall of Champions. There he drills soldiers and puts recruits through fierce combat trials.

faq.q: What is the purpose of this wing for the Scarlet Crusade?
faq.answer: The Armory is the Scarlet Crusade's main arsenal and training ground. Its forges and weapon stores supply footmen and crusaders. Its outdoor yards prepare soldiers for dispatch across Tirisfal and the Plaguelands.

faq.q: Whose statues are honored in the Hall of Champions?
faq.answer: The statues honor the Scarlet Crusade's most praised martyrs and heroes. Crusaders invoke their memory as they drill recruits for war against the undead.

angles.text: As a warrior, you can see the Armory's hard lessons in mortal combat, from stances and disarms to Herod's renowned whirlwind technique.
As a member of the Horde, you face a Scarlet Crusade army gathering outside the gates of the Undercity. Raiding its weapons and killing its champion is vital to the Forsaken's survival.
